Lena Ortiz: Quick sync on format for July webinar. Idea: a 45m 'lightning lab' focused on debugging inference flakiness + messaging A/B test for invites.
Marcus Wu: Love it. Short run: 8m context, 20m live triage lab, 10m audience debug requests, 7m CTAs. Keep it 45m.
Taryn Cole: We should A/B two registration abstracts: Ops-focused vs Product-focused. Track signups & post-webinar conversion separately.
Priya Singh: Draft two one-liners: A) Ops: "Practical fixes for latency spikes and cache warmups" B) Product: "Shipping reliable LLM features that don't break the UX". We can use A/B testing on landing page.
Maria Chen: Good. Also want tailored social copy for LinkedIn devs vs platform managers. Taryn, can you own copy variants?
Taryn Cole: Yes. I'll create 4 short variations per channel by June 10.
Marcus Wu: Speaker slate: Marcus (runtime debug demo), Lena (customer micro-postmortem), guest: Riya Patel (Platform at Wave) for 6m guest tip. Riya confirmed availability.
Lena Ortiz: I'll prep a 3-slide micro-postmortem and record a 90s fallback clip. Marcus will demo live triage with sandboxed endpoints.
Priya Singh: For A/B, we need two registration funnels: A -> Ops copy + technical claim (p95 numbers), B -> Product copy + case benefit (time-to-value). Also add a hidden field to capture attendee role.
Marcus Wu: DevRel-bot: please spin up a disposable sandbox for the lab (seeded failures + swap-to-recorded plan).
DevRel-bot: Sandbox job queued. ETA 24h. Will include seeded request logs and a short swap script.
Maria Chen: Rehearsal dates: June 25 full run, June 29 tech check. @calendar-bot create events, include green-room dial-in and backup clip upload link.
calendar-bot: Events created: "Jun 25 Full Rehearsal" and "Jun 29 Tech Check". Attachments: fallback clips folder.
Taryn Cole: Measurement plan: track CTR on A vs B, registration completion rate, attendee role split, and post-webinar CTA clicks. Priya, can you wire UTM + tracking?
Priya Singh: Will set UTM params and create two landing pages with identical form fields but different copy. Routing: role=engineer -> SDR-tech nurture, role=pm -> PM nurture drip.
Marcus Wu: Lab plan: reproducible failure #1 (KV cache cold-start), #2 (batching misconfig), #3 (in-flight model swap). Will prepare short repro steps and pre-seeded responses for fallback.
Lena Ortiz: Also adding a 1-min poll mid-session: what do you want most help with? (cost / latency / reliability / dev UX). Use this to tailor follow-ups.
Maria Chen: Final checklist to complete by Jun 12: 1) A/B landing pages live 2) speaker fallback clips uploaded 3) sandbox ready 4) copy variants in a doc 5) tracking wired 6) rehearsal invites sent. If no blockers I'll lock the plan EOD. :rocket:
